using CUDA, JSON3
function tryit(name, f)
    try; v = f(); return Dict("name" => name, "ok" => true, "value" => string(v)[1:min(end, 120)]); catch e; return Dict("name" => name, "ok" => false, "error" => first(replace(sprint(showerror, e), r"\s+" => " "), 140)); end
end
function main()
    res = Dict{String,Any}("cuda_version" => string(pkgversion(CUDA)))
    res["names_cuda"] = sort([string(n) for n in names(CUDA; all = false) if occursin(r"mem|free|avail|total|reclaim|pool"i, string(n))])
    cc = CUDA.CUDACore
    res["names_core"] = sort([string(n) for n in names(cc; all = true) if occursin(r"^(free|total|available|used|memory_info|reclaim|pool_status|cuMemGetInfo)"i, string(n))])
    res["trials"] = Any[
        tryit("CUDA.memory_info()", () -> CUDA.memory_info()),
        tryit("CUDA.free_memory()", () -> CUDA.free_memory()),
        tryit("CUDA.total_memory()", () -> CUDA.total_memory()),
        tryit("CUDA.used_memory()", () -> CUDA.used_memory()),
        tryit("CUDA.CUDACore.free_memory()", () -> CUDA.CUDACore.free_memory()),
        tryit("CUDA.CUDACore.memory_info()", () -> CUDA.CUDACore.memory_info()),
        tryit("CUDA.NVML free via device", () -> (d = CUDA.NVML.Device(CUDA.uuid(CUDA.device())); CUDA.NVML.memory_info(d))),
        tryit("CUDA.reclaim()", () -> CUDA.reclaim()),
        tryit("CUDA.pool_status()", () -> (io = IOBuffer(); CUDA.pool_status(io); String(take!(io)))),
        tryit("CUDA.cuMemGetInfo", () -> (f = Ref{Csize_t}(0); t = Ref{Csize_t}(0); CUDA.CUDACore.cuMemGetInfo_v2(f, t); (f[], t[]))),
    ]
    println(JSON3.write(res))
end
main()
